fantasy/card.prompt:

Isolated UI element on a transparent background.

Subject:
A card frame, lighter than a window: a dark walnut plate with a thin brass rim and one fine engraved line inset from it; plain mitred corners with one small brass stud each. Interior calm, even and low contrast.

Important details:
Hand-painted dark fantasy RPG interface material, original design. Palette: lamp-black stained leather and dark walnut (#1c1611 to #241c15) for the inner plate, aged burnished brass (#8f7650) with warm highlights (#d9b45f) for the rim.
